about.title: About Teranoo ERP Knowledge Hub
about.subtitle: The Complete Journey of Building an Enterprise ERP System — an ERP encyclopedia, engineering guide, and living architecture platform for Teranoo ERP.
about.visionTitle: Comprehensive Platform Vision & Six Complementary Concepts
about.visionBody: Teranoo ERP Knowledge Hub is designed to document the complete lifecycle of building an enterprise ERP system — from discovery, research, and architecture through engineering, testing, deployment, operations, and continuous evolution — uniting six complementary concepts:

concepts.c1Body: Structured reference covering ERP domain concepts, business processes, business rules, and structural models.
concepts.c2Body: Practical engineering guide explaining architectural patterns, domain modeling, and scalable platform design.
concepts.c3Body: Connected, evolving documentation of approved decisions, business modules, shared platform capabilities, and dependencies.
concepts.c4Body: Repository of comparative benchmarks, research evidence, and independent reviews clearly separated from approved decisions.
concepts.c5Body: Extensible foundation ready for screen specifications, data models, integration contracts, test plans, and deployment guides.
concepts.c6Body: Transparent documentation of real Teranoo ERP implementation tasks, technical issues, solutions, and lessons learned.

about.purposeBody: This application serves as an authoritative, structured workspace for understanding Teranoo ERP's vision, architecture, approved decisions, research evidence, independent reviews, and engineering journey. It is not an operational ERP system, not a marketing website, and not a plain Markdown viewer.

purposeRows.r1Is: Structured encyclopedia, engineering guide, and architecture hub for Teranoo ERP
purposeRows.r2Is: Interconnected knowledge workspace for decisions, research, reviews, and engineering journals
purposeRows.r3Is: Public read-only knowledge platform built incrementally via governed tasks
purposeRows.r3IsNot: Not a plain Markdown viewer or disposable prototype

about.classificationBody: The platform enforces an explicit visual and semantic distinction across eight authority classifications so research evidence, advisory reviews, educational guides, illustrative models, and engineering logs are never conflated with approved ERP decisions.
about.publicAccessTitle: Approved Product Direction — Public Read-Only Knowledge Platform & Publishing Governance
about.publicAccessBody: By explicit approval of the project owner, Teranoo ERP Knowledge Hub operates as a publicly accessible read-only knowledge-sharing platform for authorized architectural documentation. User authentication is not required for public read-only access, and the application repository may remain public.

publicAccessGuardrails.authorization: Publishing any project document still requires explicit authorization and scope verification.
publicAccessGuardrails.noSecrets: Secrets, API keys, credentials, access tokens, customer data, and sensitive operational information must never be published.
publicAccessGuardrails.attribution: Source attribution and intellectual property notices must be preserved; public repository visibility does not automatically grant an open-source software license.
publicAccessGuardrails.separation: Source repository visibility and deployed application access control are distinct security boundaries.

engineeringJournal.distinctionTitle: Critical Project Distinction: Teranoo ERP vs. Teranoo ERP Knowledge Hub
engineeringJournal.distinctionBody: Development tasks for this documentation platform (such as TASK-001 and TASK-002) are strictly distinct from engineering work on the Teranoo ERP software product itself.

distinctionRows.r1Erp: Commercial modular enterprise ERP product (Finance, Inventory, Procurement, Sales)
distinctionRows.r1Hub: Public read-only documentation & knowledge platform chronicling the ERP journey
distinctionRows.r2Erp: Architectural planning & approval stage (Phase 5) — software engineering not started
distinctionRows.r2Hub: Incremental platform implementation (TASK-001 approved, TASK-002 reviewed, TASK-003 in progress)
distinctionRows.r3Erp: In this Engineering Journal (/engineering-journal) once real ERP engineering starts
distinctionRows.r3Hub: In Knowledge Hub task completion reports (docs/TASK-*-COMPLETION_REPORT.md)

engineeringJournal.anatomyTitle: Planned Structure of Future Engineering Journal Entries
engineeringJournal.anatomyBody: The content architecture already registers structured engineering types (engineering-journal-entry, development-task, technical-issue, solution-record, lesson-learned) designed around verifiable fields:

anatomyItems.objective: Engineering objective linked to official Decision and Requirement IDs.
anatomyItems.actualDate: Actual execution date (never fabricated or estimated).
anatomyItems.workItem: ERP work item reference and target business module or platform domain.
anatomyItems.problemRootCause: Technical issue description and documented root cause.
anatomyItems.solution: Evaluated alternatives, chosen solution, and engineering rationale.
anatomyItems.testing: Actual test evidence and verification results.
